function wrap<T,U>(fn: (value:T) => U): (value:T) => U { return value => fn(value); }
function id<T>(value: T): T { return value; }
const generic = wrap(id);
const wrong: number = generic('text');
const keyed = wrap(<T extends { key: string }>(value:T) => value);
keyed({ count: 1 });
function tagged<T, U>(fn: (value:T) => U): { (value:T): U; tag: string } {
  return Object.assign((value:T) => fn(value), { tag: 'token' });
}
const stillUnknown: number = tagged(id)(1);
function fixed<T>(fixedValue:T, callback: (value:T) => T): (value:T) => T { return callback; }
const onlyNumbers = fixed(1, id);
onlyNumbers('text');
function overloaded(value: number): number;
function overloaded<T>(value: T): T;
function overloaded(value: unknown) { return value; }
const stillOverloaded: number = wrap(overloaded)(1);
